description: Data centers explode while big-city office REITs collapse — the COVID remote-work shock + cloud & AI compute boom rewrote commercial real estate. This chart race shows Equinix & Digital Realty skyrocketing as Vornado and Boston Properties get crushed (2007–2026).
youtube_description:
The Office Graveyard: how the cloud & AI compute boom vaporized downtown office valuations and turned data centers into the new skyscrapers. This visualization charts 2007–2026 market caps (billions USD) for two data-center REITs (Equinix, Digital Realty) and two legacy office REITs (Vornado, Boston Properties).

What happened? COVID-19 accelerated remote/hybrid work and sent office vacancy & sublease inventory skyrocketing (2020–2022). Meanwhile cloud adoption and the AI compute arms race exploded demand for hyperscale data centers — driving massive capital inflows into Equinix and Digital Realty. Vornado and big downtown office owners have seen valuations crater as tenants shrink footprints and lending tightens. The result is a dramatic chart race: winners = compute infrastructure; losers = legacy office landlords.

If you want more deep-dive videos like this (market caps, timelines, and flashpoints), subscribe and hit the bell. Tell us in the comments which skyline will survive the AI era — office towers or server farms? Like, share, and save this for your next debate.

Sources & notes: market-cap series reflect public-company market caps and major events (COVID remote-work shock 2020, office vacancy spikes, hyperscaler capacity expansions and AI-capex surge 2023–2026). Projections after 2024 reflect observed trends in cloud/AI demand and office-market pressure.
